authorization: Continue the exact all-record l1 contraction after uniform nested charge retention hit the state cap.
question: Can an adaptive decision diagram refine only ambiguous charge prefixes and tighten the L5,p=.08 certified LER interval under the same state budget?
frozen_model: Canonical L5 square, exact ternary current prior, every public charge emitted in the minimum-width elimination order, rough endpoints and exact logical parity.

method.node_bound: For each charge prefix, sum frontier weights by partial logical parity, then analytically convolve the parity of all unassigned logical-cut edges. min(Z0_prefix,Z1_prefix) is a valid upper bound on every refinement of that prefix.
method.adaptive_rule: At each detector, retain the B prefixes with largest current Bayes-risk contribution and finalize all others at their certified coarse upper bound.
method.leaf_result: The sum of finalized-prefix bounds plus exact risks of surviving full records is a deterministic upper bound on full-record LER.
method.baseline: Combine with the completed k=4 activity lower/upper interval.

acceptance: All no-prune L3 runs reproduce exact LER within 1e-12; every pruned run remains above exact LER and below the zero-charge-information prior risk.
Every finalized node includes the exact remaining logical-parity convolution; total represented plus finalized probability is one within 1e-10.
Promote a budget/cell only if it reduces the registered activity interval width by at least 10%. Report the deterministic selection rule, finalized prefixes and peak active states.
Fail closed at two million pre-prune states; do not increase budgets after the first cap.
stop_rule: Stop after the frozen budgets or first state-cap failure. No size, p or decoder extension.
decision: Promote the B=1024 adaptive decision diagram for L5,p=.08 at q=.97 and q=1: it reduces certified interval width by 24.95% and 30.69%. It does not meet the 10% gate at q=.5 or .75. All B=4096 runs exceed the registered pre-prune state cap and are censored.
next_action: Retain the promoted near-directed bounds. Register one bounded alternative branch priority or structured merge for q=.5,.75; do not increase B or interpret the censored B=4096 runs.
